rationale: Y independently surfaces the same core registry.py builder-less passthrough regression X found, but backs it with actual runtime reproductions (LingBot mode resolution, stage-modality warning) rather than static evidence quotes alone, and its 'Smaller items' section directly matches three of the eight GT comments (the import-aliasing/shadowing critique in __init__.py, and the deleted-test-not-rehomed concern). X's report repeatedly asserts 'no entrypoints/openai serving file changed' as a validated fact to support its 'online serving unchanged' narrative, which is contradicted by the ground truth reviewer leaving a comment directly on vllm_omni/entrypoints/openai/serving_video.py:30 — a real factual miss that dents precision. Both reviews are highly actionable with concrete file:line fixes, but Y edges ahead on rigor (it explicitly tests and refutes its own num_frames hypothesis) and topical overlap with the human reviewer's actual concerns.
